final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(a.link_to_member) as attendee_count FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code GROUP BY z.city), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(attendee_count) as total, COUNT(*) as num_cities FROM city_counts), city_shares AS (SELECT city_counts.city, city_counts.attendee_count, CAST(city_counts.attendee_count AS FLOAT) / total_count.total as share FROM city_counts, total_count) SELECT AVG(attendee_count) as avg_attendees, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM city_counts))) as avg_above_average FROM city_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM city_shares)
